name: Event e Ikou! Sono 4
original_name: イベントへ行こう!その4
source:
Go to a convention, and have sex with a cosplayer!
A must-see girl who becomes your favorite character, as though she's coming out of the product to you!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ066289.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=5007]Katsuragi Misato[/url] from Neon Genesis Evangelion.
translation:
去漫展和cosplayer做爱吧！化身为心仪角色的女孩们，仿佛从作品中走出来一样，不容错过！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ066289.html]DLsite[/url]]

收录了《新世纪福音战士》中的[url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=5007]葛城美里[/url]。
